errors.text: The central morphology mechanism is reversed: the target attributes improved fracture strain to the reticulated Laves phase impeding crack extension and compensating plasticity, whereas the generated hypothesis treats the network as a continuous brittle crack path.
The predicted fracture-strain trend is opposite to the target and actual result: the hypothesis predicts a decrease, while the Cr-containing alloy increases from about 11.6% to 14.0%.
The proposed annealing or aging treatment is not part of the target intervention, which uses vacuum arc melting and evaluates the as-cast alloy.
The mechanical-test specification shifts from room-temperature compression to tensile testing, reducing condition agreement.
